name: Greece
exam_name: Εξετάσεις Πιστοποιητικού Επάρκειας Γνώσεων για Πολιτογράφηση (Π.Ε.Γ.Π.)

format.notes: Greek language (60 points) and thematic units on geography, history, culture and political institutions (40 points). Reported pass rule: 70 of 100 overall, with at least 40 of 60 in language and 20 of 40 in the thematic units. Held twice a year nationwide.

unverified.format: The pass rule and structure come from a search summary of the ministry’s own announcements; the ministry page that could be opened only links to the examination site and question bank.

notes: The ministry publishes the bank the exam questions are drawn from. The examination site would not load here, so its licence terms were not read.
